display_name: HPT capacity-staged heat pump placeholder (individual test)
notes: Public placeholder for the HPT individual test on a capacity-staged (non-inverter) heat pump. unit_type is air_water until the source medium is confirmed; staging means on/off cycling is expected, so cycle classification matters more than for modulating units. Export files with the prefix HPT_RRT6_STAGED_ so they resolve to this profile; no hp_id alias on purpose. Set climate and application per test (no BAM Average/MT default).
